fix(search): stop stale results repainting a closed sheet, collapse duplicate country rows, wire the city button on skeleton/offline

Three defects in the search & geocoding path (rotation area 8):

1. A search in flight when the sheet closed still painted. closeSheet() only
   cleared the debounce timer; the request already on the wire resolved,
   matched qSeq (which only moves when a *new* search starts) and called
   paintSheet(). Reopening the sheet showed "Popular", then a second later a
   "Results" block for a query the box no longer contained. openSheet() and
   closeSheet() now bump qSeq, so an in-flight search is invalidated exactly
   the way a newer keystroke invalidates it.

2. Country searches listed the same city twice. The bundled list was merged
   with the geocoder's answer and de-duplicated by toLowerCase() only; the
   geocoder returns "Istanbul" with a capital dotted I for "turkiye", whose
   lowercase carries a combining dot and so never matched the bundled
   "Istanbul". Both sides are now compared with fold(), which the local
   matcher already uses.

3. The city-name button was dead on the offline screen and the loading
   skeleton: render() binds #openSearch to openSheet(), renderSkeleton() and
   renderError() built the same button without binding it. Offline, the only
   route to search was the Cities tab. Both renders now bind it.

No UI change: loaded, skeleton and offline #main markup are byte-identical to
1.4.3, computed styles identical, zero console errors in a full interactive
pass, node --check clean. versionCode 23 / 1.4.4, same signing key, APK
rebundles the identical index.html and CHECKSUMS.txt carries its digest.
